weak.scope: Validation search; no new test evaluation or production replacement
weak.points: Pair-weighted distance MSE; clip-weighted Rec; triplet-weighted ranking. Work-bootstrap contrasts are separate estimands.
weak.limitations: One seed; prior test motivated search; validation intervals are exploratory and do not correct adaptive selection.

protocol.cap: Same .25 budget against UNWEIGHTED Rec gradient; do not rescale cap by alpha; effective lambda remains adaptive
protocol.controls: Same initialization, seed, batch order, nominal G weight, optimizer, fixed horizon and preservation rules
protocol.checkpoint: Last epoch at fixed horizon; no best-epoch search for candidates
protocol.useful_weak_rec: Common guards pass; >=.1% work-macro Rec improvement vs G-only; adjusted CI upper<0; pair MSE <=1.01*G-only; ranking>=G-only-1pp
protocol.selection: Among useful weak candidates minimize validation G score; otherwise alpha0. Also report minimum-G-score guard-passing candidate separately.
protocol.uncertainty: Exploratory paired work bootstrap5000; nine new comparisons per outcome; intervals do not correct for adaptive validation selection
protocol.scope: Existing test motivated this search; no new independent confirmation; no production replacement
